spans.s: जय n. 1. Conquest, triumph, victory, R.iii.57; 2. winning (as a game or lawsuit); 3. curbing, restraining, as in इंद्रियविजय; 4. an epithet of Jayanta, son of Indra; 5. of Yudhiṣṭhira, the first Pāṇḍava prince; 6. name of an attendant of Viṣṇu; 7. an epithet of Arjuna.
जया f. 1. Name of an attendant of the goddess Durgā; 2. a kind of flag.
जय्य a. (f. य्या) Conquerable, vulnerable.
जय्य a. (f. य्या) Conquerable, vulnerable.

जाया f. A wife, R.ii.1, Megh.i.8, 10. The word is thus derived- पतिर्भार्यां संप्रविश्य गर्भो भूत्वेह जायते । जयायास्तद्धि जायार्वं यदस्यां जायते पुनः M.ix.8. See also Mall. on R.ii.1. As the last member of a Bahu. compound, जाया is changed to जानि, e.g. युवजानि ‘one who has a young wife,’ नमो वामार्धजानये Mall.
जय-आवह a. conferring victory.
जय-उद्धुर a. exulting in victory.
जय-कोलाहल m. 1. a shout of victory; 2. a kind of game with dice.
जय-घोष m. a cry of victory.
जय-घोषण n. a cry of victory.
जय-घोषणा f. a cry of victory.
जय-ढक्का f. a kind of drum beaten as a sign of victory.
जय-पत्र n. a record of victory.
जय-पाल m. 1. a king; 2. an epithet of Brahman (m.); 3. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
जय-पुत्रक m. a kind of dice.
जय-मंगल m. a royal elephant.
जय-वाहिनी f. an epithet of Śachī.
जय-शब्द m. 1. a shout of victory; 2. the exclamation ‘Jaya.’
जय-स्तंभ m. a trophy, a column erected to commemorate a victory, निचखान जयस्तंभान् गंगास्रोतोंतरेषु सः R.iv.36, 69.
जयन n. 1. Conquering, subduing; 2. armour for cavalry &c.
जयन-युज् a. 1. caparisoned; 2. victorious.
जयंत m. 1. Name of the son of Indra, R.iii.23, vi.78; 2. an epithet of Śiva; 3. the moon.
जयंत-पत्र n. 1. the written award of the judge in favour of either party (in law); 2. the label on the forehead of a horse turned loose for the Aśvamedha sacrifice.
जयंती f. 1. A flag or banner; 2. name of the daughter of Indra.

जयिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Conquering, victorious, पौरस्त्यानेवमाक्रामंस्ताञ्जनपदाञ्जयी R.iv.34; 2. winning (as a lawsuit); 3. captivating, taking possession of the heart, जगति जयिनस्ते ते भावा नवेंदुकलादयः M.M.i.
जायिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Conquering, subduing.
जायिन् (II) m. The burden of a song (in music).

जयिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Conquering, victorious, पौरस्त्यानेवमाक्रामंस्ताञ्जनपदाञ्जयी R.iv.34; 2. winning (as a lawsuit); 3. captivating, taking possession of the heart, जगति जयिनस्ते ते भावा नवेंदुकलादयः M.M.i.
जायिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Conquering, subduing.
जाया-अनुजीविन्, -आजीव m. 1. an actor, a dancer; 2. the husband of a harlot; 3. a needy man, a pauper.
जाया-अनुजीविन्, -आजीव m. 1. an actor, a dancer; 2. the husband of a harlot; 3. a needy man, a pauper.
जायापती m. du. husband and wife. Cf. जंपती and दंपती.
जायु m. Medicine, drug.
